messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- Hark! The century had begun, and the world trembled at its awakening.
- Behold, the great nations fell into ruin, their banners scorched beneath the ash of iron fire.
- Yet a new dawn broke forth, and the sons of the earth beheld a sky ablaze with the promise of rebirth.
- Lo, the age of steel and thunder did proclaim its dominion, its voice a rattle of war across every continent.
- At length, the weary hours of darkness surrendered, yielding the globe to a radiance of eternal morning.
